text.title: RSpec Testing for Rails Applications Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a RSpec Testing for Rails Applications artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `rspec-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/ruby-rspec-testing.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Spec-authoring sub-procedure (expands steps 3 and 4 when the artefact ships real specs)

step.name: scaffold-spec
step.action: Create `spec/<unit|requests>/<path>_spec.rb` wrapped in `RSpec.describe <SUT> do ... end`. Decide `spec_helper` vs `rails_helper` here, not later.

step.name: model-state-with-context
step.action: Group by precondition — `context "when X" do ... end` — with each context carrying only its own setup.
step.output: Hierarchical spec body whose failure output reads as a sentence.

step.name: build-stubbed-or-create
step.action: If the example asserts on DB state, `create(:resource)`. Otherwise `build_stubbed(:resource)`.
step.decision-gate: A unit spec using `create(:x)` with no DB assertion - STOP and switch to `build_stubbed`.

step.name: extract-shared-examples
step.action: Once two or more specs check the same invariant, extract `shared_examples_for "auditable"` into `spec/support/shared/` and include it via `it_behaves_like`.

step.name: run-and-profile
step.action: Run `bundle exec rspec --profile 10`; convert the slowest `create` call sites to `build_stubbed` where no persistence is asserted.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
